meta.title: Domi Adiwijaya
meta.description: Tekku to homurabo no purofesshonaru enthujiiasuto, Domi Adiwijaya no poriforio, gijutsu insaito, oyobi kakushin-teki na purojekuto o go-ran kudasai.

hero.blurb: Watashi wa shinrai dekiru shisutemu o sekkei shi teikyo shimasu. Homurabo a-kitekucha kara seisan-ki no otomeshon made, fukuzatsu na yokken o yuga de kyoyu na kaiketsu ni shite todokemasu.

about.lead: Kontororu sareta homurabo demo, genba no fukuzatsu na kadai no kaiketsu demo, gijutsu o imi aru mono ni yoku suru koto o mezashite imasu.
about.p1: Watashi wa Domi desu. Nagai aida, teknorojisuto to shite no kyoumi o, jissai no seikai de yakudatsu shisutemu sekkei no kisoku e to migakiagete kimashita.
about.p2: Watashi no homurabo wa shuchu shita R&D no kankyo desu. Iden o tesuto de koshi, toki ni aete kowashi, kyoka shi, jissho sareta mono o seisan-ki ni nobashimasu.
about.p3: Kitei ya otomeshon o koete, mananda koto o bunsho ya demo de katachi ni shite kyoyu shi, hoka no hito ga fukuzatsu-sei o hayaku navi-geito dekiru yō ni shimasu. Subete ga kanpeki ni ugoki dasu shunkan ga mokuhyo desu.

bullets.1: Homurabo R&D, jissen-teki na mondai kaiketsusha
bullets.4: Tsune ni manabu hito, kihonteki ni koukishin ousei

innovation.title: Tekku inobeshon
innovation.description: Shinshutsu no gijutsu o hyoka shi, yuga de sukera-buru na kaiketsu o sekkei shite, jūdaina mondai ni taisho shimasu.

homelab.title: Homurabo R&D
homelab.description: Jissou mae ni a-idea o tesuto, kyoka, seihin-ka suru tame no kontororu sareta kankyo desu.

automation.title: Otomeshon daiichi
automation.description: Onaji sagyo o 2-kai kurikaeshitara, sore wa shinrai dekiru idempotento na otomeshon no taisho desu.

sharing.title: Chishiki kyouyuu
sharing.description: Mananda koto o bunsho, demo, tokuhon ni seiri shi, chimu no gakushu o sokushin shimasu.

skills.lead: Fuerodo ni mo shippai ji ni mo yowakunai shisutemu o sekkei, otomeshon, un'ei suru tame no tsu-ru chein desu.

tail.title: Manabi o yamenaide
tail.body: Gijutsu wa hibi shinka shimasu. Watashi wa tsune ni shinken o tsuzuke, atarashii tsu-ru o tesuto shi, jitsumu o migaki, kekka o meikakuka shimasu.

services.lead: End to end no infura kara, kono ichibu no mendouna sagyo made, jissen-teki de kyoka na kaiketsu o teikyo shimasu.

homelab.title: Homurabo settoappu
homelab.description: Resilien-su no aru nettowaku, kasouka, sutore-ji o kiso to shita, gakushu, suteeji, self-hosting ni tekisuru homurabo o sekkei to deploy shimasu.

cloud.title: Kuraudo migureshon
cloud.description: Genjitsu-teki de kosuto o ishiki shita keikaku to tekisetsu na mokuhyo a-kitekucha de, kuraudo e no idou no risuku o sakugen shimasu.

security.title: Seikyuriti settei
security.description: Delivery o osoku sezu ni, jittai-teki ni risuku o herasu seikyuriti kontororu o seichi shimasu.

automation.title: Shinrai dekiru otomeshon
automation.description: Toil o haisyo shi, taisetsu na kekka ni shusho dekiru you, kyoka de idempotento na otomeshon o teikyo shimasu.

monitoring.title: Monitaringu to a-ra-to
monitoring.description: Yuza ga eikyo o kanjiru zutto mae ni, shisutemu no jokyo o katsudotekini haaku shimasu.

data.title: De-ta to bakkappu
data.description: Juyo na de-ta o kyoka na bakkappu, hayai kaifuku, seikatsu saikuru no kanri de mamorimasu.

tail.title: Hoka no goyobo wa arimasu ka?
tail.body: Basho mo bunmyaku mo samazama desu. Hitsuyou na koto o oshiete kudasai. Mokuhyo, seiyaku, sukeruju ni awasete, tekisetsu na kaiketsu o issho ni dezain shimasu.

contact.lead: Scope o kime-tai purojekuto ya, himotsuku beki mondai ga arimasu ka? Mokuhyo o rikai shi, jissai-teki na furō o teian shimasu.

drop.title: Messe-ji o okutte kudasai
drop.body: Fomu mata wa e-me-ru, tsukaiyasui ho o erande kudasai. Subete no messe-ji ni me o tooshimasu.

form.message_ph: Mokuhyo, seiyaku, sukeruju o kanketsu ni oshiete kudasai.

connect.title: Tsunagarimashou
connect.body: Kosei shien, sukera, mata wa dainintei ga hitsuyou na baai mo, tsugi no suteppu o meikaku ni shite go-annai shimasu.

error404.p: O-sagashi no peji wa sonzai shinai ka, iten saremashita.
